dataset.name: WTC 1 V8K Floor 96 NIST topology audit
dataset.scope: Replace the V8I nearest-four cut boundary around core Columns 503, 504, 505 and 604 with the orthogonal core-beam paths visible in NIST NCSTAR 1-6C Figure 5-59, then retest the post-impact 20 C gate.
dataset.warning: This is a local transcription of an official-model figure, not an as-built beam schedule. The refined NIST Case A/B impact damage was never used in the full-floor model, and vertical loads were not applied to the tops of the columns in that subsystem analysis.

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
official_facts.fact: Figure 2-2 identifies the Floor 96 core-column locations and numbers used to register the Figure 5-59 beam plan.

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
official_facts.fact: The full-floor base model was developed from the converted SAP2000 Floor 96 model and included core beams, slab, trusses, exterior/core columns and connection break elements.
official_facts.confidence: high for the official model description; it is not an as-built schedule

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL_LIMITE
official_facts.fact: Refined Case A/B impact damage was never used in the full-floor model. Only severed columns were removed; damaged-but-not-severed columns were retained as undamaged. Case Ai structural damage was reused for Case Bi because Case Bi was not available at computation time.

figure_transcription.source_figure: NIST NCSTAR 1-6C Figure 5-59(b), Case Ai model with damage
figure_transcription.registration: Column centroids registered from Figure 2-2 to the orthographic beam-plan panel; North is at the top.
figure_transcription.scope: Only the seven V8J cut-boundary edges are classified. The complete 46,280-element full-floor model is not reverse-engineered from the raster figure.

model_hypotheses.incoming_loads: Loads arriving at Floor 96 are replayed from the validated V8J cold path through Floors 99, 98 and 97. They remain outputs of the V8I/V8J reduced model, not measured column loads.
model_hypotheses.local_topology_rule: Figure 5-59 is used only to accept, reject or mark ambiguous the seven V8J cut-boundary connections. No diagonal nearest-four edge is retained unless an orthogonal path is visible.
model_hypotheses.support_rule: A removed Floor 96 column is locally supported only if the figure shows a continuous beam route to at least one surviving core-column node.
model_hypotheses.force_displacement_rule: Topology is tested before capacity. A loaded node with no surviving path has zero local transfer capacity regardless of the assumed beam section.
model_hypotheses.candidate_505_path: The visible 505-506 and 505-605 paths are screened with the inherited 14WF136 plus cold-upper slab law only as a proxy sensitivity; that section is not claimed as the as-built Floor 96 assignment.

gate.required_condition: Every loaded removed-column node must have a surviving, mechanically specified path with sourced topology, section, connection, stiffness and deformation capacity.
gate.pass_policy: A figure-constrained topology may falsify the local Floor 96 bridge hypothesis, but cannot validate the whole building or contradict observed stability when multistory frame action and global redistribution are omitted.
